findings.claim: MCP base64 payload size limits are enforced only after decoding, allowing an oversized request to allocate unbounded memory before rejection.
findings.evidence: In `decode_bounded`, `URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.decode(encoded)` materializes the full `Vec<u8>` before `if bytes.len() > limit`; `build_request` relies on this for `codeBase64` and inputs with `MAX_CODE_BYTES`/`MAX_INPUT_BYTES`, while the MCP schema in `docs/reference/api/prometheus-exec.mcp.json` has no `maxLength` for those string fields.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject by encoded length before decoding, add schema `maxLength` values derived from the byte limits, and stream or chunk-decode if larger payloads must be supported.
